Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 43 (Digital Realty missing-address campaign): matched two rows sharing the identical operator assigned PDX11 building name to the one address carrying that same building code, flagged as a likely duplicate underlying map entity.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row is one of two entries in this registry both named Digital Realty PDX11 Data Center, sitting only about 250 meters apart. A datacenterHawk listing whose own building code exactly matches this rows name, PDX11, gives 6675 NE 62nd Avenue, described variously as Portland or Hillsboro, OR, which this session applied to both rows given they already share the identical operator assigned building name PDX11 rather than being matched on name alone. The operators own Portland market page, fetched fresh this session, lists only two other named buildings, PDX10 at 3825 NW Aloclek Street and PDX12 at 5870 NE Schaaf Street, neither matching this rows own PDX11 name, so this session did not reassign either row to those addresses. The two PDX11 rows likely represent a single building or campus mapped twice in the underlying geographic data, a possible duplicate entity a future researcher could resolve.
